pairs.question: Utrum appetitus sit aliqua specialis animae potentia?
pairs.answer: Necesse est ponere quandam potentiam animae appetitivam.
pairs.derivation: The scholastic quaestio title (ARTICULUS 1) is the genuine interrogative posed by the author; 'Utrum...' = 'whether'. The answer is the body's 'Respondeo dicendum quod...' which directly resolves it. Dropped the framing 'Respondeo dicendum quod' (meta-narration of answering) and took the operative first sentence to the first full stop; what follows ('Ad cuius evidentiam, considerandum est quod...') is elaboration/argument, so cut there.

pairs.question: Utrum appetitus sensitivus et intellectivus sint diversae potentiae?
pairs.answer: Necesse est dicere appetitum intellectivum esse aliam potentiam a sensitivo.
pairs.derivation: The scholastic quaestio title (ARTICULUS 2) is the genuine interrogative; answered by the body's 'Respondeo dicendum quod...'. Dropped the framing 'Respondeo dicendum quod' and took the operative first sentence to the first full stop; what follows ('Potentia enim appetitiva est potentia passiva...') is the supporting argument, so cut there.
